info.description:
API collection for the Digi-Fuel-Route optimization service.

Set the `base_url` environment variable to your server address (default: http://localhost:8000).

Import this collection, set base_url, then run requests in order. The first request to /optimize/ may take ~2s on a cold cache (2 geocode + 1 OSRM call). Repeat requests complete in ~430ms from DB cache.
info.name: Fuel Route Optimization

request.description: Liveness check. Returns 200 with {"status": "ok"}. Never calls external providers.

item.name: POST /optimize/ — New York to Chicago (cold cache)

request.description:
Multi-stop ~791-mile trip. Cold cache: 2 Nominatim + 1 OSRM call (~2 s). Warm: 0 external calls (~430 ms). Returns 4 fuel stops totalling ~$101.

Note: geometry has 12,659 coordinates — response is large (~285 KB). The coordinates array is truncated in this example.

response.name: 200 — Optimized route (cold cache)

item.name: POST /optimize/ — New York to Chicago (warm cache)

request.description: Same request repeated. Shows cached_geocodes: {start: true, finish: true} and cached_route: true. Zero external provider calls. ~430ms response time.
Long-haul trip (~1,400 miles) requiring multiple fuel stops.
Start with only 10 gallons (100-mile immediate range). Forces an early first stop, then subsequent stops to cover the ~790 mile route.
Same start and finish. Returns 200 with empty fuel_stops and zero cost.
Returns 400 with DRF field-level validation error.
Non-US location returns 400 with detail message.
